title: Virginia Military Institute
summary: Terraced parking on South Institute Hill, concealed from Main Street behind limestone walls.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. The year and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Full landscape architectural services for critically needed parking area occupying VMI's South Institute Hill. Terraced design conceals parked cars from Main Street, continues VMI theme of Lexington-quarried limestone foundation walls, and provides a safe pedestrian route to sports arenas.
